findings.passage: I believe the state should not preempt cities from creating ordinances that protect their residents. Utah currently prohibits cities from enacting reasonable rent controls, setting a higher minimum wage, designing walkable streets, and adopting gun measures better suited for cities. Issues like these are best handled locally, where leaders are closest to the people affected.
